markdown.markdown: I believe I am passionate in teaching statistics, econometrics, and programming. I love coding and statistical theories and I want my students will love them too ... but that doesn't always happen. ## ![EWU Logo](images/ewu-logo.svg){width=30 height=20} East West University, Bangladesh #### ECO 204: Statistics for Business and Economics II **Institution:** East West University This course covers inferential statistics including point and interval estimation, hypothesis testing, simple and multiple linear regression, basic time series analysis, and ANOVA techniques. The course emphasizes both theoretical understanding and practical application using R programming. **Key Features:** - Balanced approach between theory and practice - Extensive use of R programming for statistical analysis - Group lab projects for hands-on experience - Comprehensive problem sets and quizzes **Semesters Taught:** - **Fall 2023:** [Course Materials](eco204.qmd) | [Course Outline](teaching/ewu/eco204/Eco204_outline_Fall2023.pdf) - **Summer 2025:** [Course Website](https://ewu-econ.github.io/eco204) #### ECO 104: Statistics for Business and Economics I **Institution:** East West University Introductory statistics course covering probability theory, descriptive statistics, and basic statistical inference. This course provides the foundation for advanced statistical methods. **Semesters Taught:** - **Fall 2023:** [Course Materials](eco104.qmd) | [Course Outline](teaching/ewu/eco104/Eco104_outline_Fall2023.pdf) - **Summer 2025:** [Course Website](https://ewu-econ.github.io/eco104) ## ![TU Dortmund Logo](images/TudoLogo.jpeg){width=30 height=30} TU Dortmund University, Germany #### Programming with Julia **Semester:** Spring 2021 **Institution:** TU Dortmund University Intensive 5-day programming course introducing Julia language for scientific computing. The course covered basic syntax, type systems, multiple dispatch, performance optimization, and metaprogramming. **Course Structure:** - 5-day intensive format with live Zoom sessions - Hands-on exercises with Jupyter notebooks - Graded assignments and live quiz evaluation - Focus on high-performance scientific computing [Course Materials](julia_course.qmd)
